dedupe_keys.name: 232 indonesian dams dataset catchment river length slope and curve number

description: This dataset gives, for 232 dams in Indonesia, the location and three catchment attributes needed for rainfall runoff modelling of their reservoirs: river length, slope and the SCS curve number. Dam coordinates were identified on satellite imagery and cross-checked with government data, length and slope were computed in HEC-HMS 4.11, and the curve number was derived with an R script from the national land use map and hydrologic soil group map. A researcher at the Bandung Institute of Technology published it on Zenodo in April 2024 as one small CSV file, available as a free download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is national. Caveats: it holds only these attributes, not dam heights, capacities or purposes, and the method depends on the national maps used. Simulation uses: inflow design floods and reservoir operation models for hazard exposure and capacity planning. Related records: DAM-In for India (data-dam-in-india-dam-catchment-attributes) and the Italian large dams catchment attributes (data-italian-large-dams-catchment-attributes).
